brief.HEADLINE: October 2026 revenue EUR 299.1M vs EUR 305.3M budget
brief.DETAIL: EBITDA EUR 54.1M vs EUR 55.3M budget; first month of FY2027 (Halloween Festival).

brief.HEADLINE: Hotel revenue EUR 3.3M below budget — occupancy, not ADR
brief.DETAIL: October RevPAR EUR 325.6 vs EUR 328.9 forecast: occupancy 88.2% vs 90.5%, ADR EUR 369 vs EUR 363. Hotel Santa Fe and Davy Crockett Ranch run 6–7 points behind on weaker UK package pickup.

brief.HEADLINE: Disney Adventure World visits +35% since the new lands opened
brief.DETAIL: Merchandise per cap EUR 17.08 vs EUR 15.78 a year earlier (+8%). Cast overtime 10.0% of hours vs a 5.5% standard on Park 2 peak days: EUR 2.9M above budget since 29 March.

brief.HEADLINE: UK & Ireland visits 8.8% below budget since June
brief.DETAIL: GBP/EUR moved from 0.84 to 0.88. French domestic visits +4.9% and Annual Pass visits above budget offset most of the admissions gap, but with lower hotel attach.

brief.HEADLINE: FY2027 1+11 Forecast EUR 3,090M revenue, EUR 559M EBITDA (18.1%)
brief.DETAIL: EUR 60M below the EUR 3,150M budget; EBITDA EUR 12M below the EUR 571M budget. Gap: Resort Hotels −EUR 35M, Entertainment & Events −EUR 15M, Theme Parks −EUR 20M, Merchandise +EUR 10M.

brief.HEADLINE: UK −8% and energy +30% would take EUR 43.6M off FY2027 EBITDA (to EUR 515M, 16.9%)
brief.DETAIL: Before mitigation; re-contracting 60% of energy and a +2% pricing tier on UK packages recover about a third (EUR 14.7M).

brief.HEADLINE: Three decisions for the November forecast
brief.DETAIL: 1) Re-roster Park 2 F&B and attractions to the ML attendance forecast (overtime back to 6%). 2) Targeted UK package offer for Santa Fe and Davy Crockett Ranch for Christmas. 3) Lock 60% of FY2027 electricity before 31 December.
